#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, datetime, urllib.request
GIST_ID="7181de8f94858379915d85d0a04bcbef"
LOG="/home/ubuntu/bot/freeze-capture.log"
def age():
 try:
  r=urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com/gists/"+GIST_ID,headers={"User-Agent":"t"})
  d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=15))
  dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(d["updated_at"].replace("Z","+00:00"))
  return int((datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)-dt).total_seconds()/60)
 except: return -1
def run(c):
 try: return subprocess.run(c,shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20).stdout
 except Exception as e: return str(e)
a=age()
if a>6:
 ts=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
 with open(LOG,"a") as f:
  f.write("\n===FREEZE "+ts+" age="+str(a)+"min===\n")
  f.write("---ps-cpu---\n"+run("ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -25"))
  f.write("---ps-py---\n"+run("ps aux | grep python | grep -v grep"))
  f.write("---mem---\n"+run("free -m"))
  f.write("---locks---\n"+run("ls -lh /home/ubuntu/bot/*.lock 2>&1"))
PYEOF
chmod +x /home/ubuntu/bot/freeze-trap.py && (crontab -l | grep -v freeze-watch | grep -v freeze-trap; echo '*/3 * * * * /usr/bin/python3 /home/ubuntu/bot/freeze-trap.py >/dev/null 2>&1') | crontab - && echo TRAP_OK && crontab -l | grep freeze
